_comment: Who has signed the Contributor License Agreement in CLA.md.
This file is the record. Signing is a pull request that adds an entry here
and changes nothing else; merging it is what records the agreement, and the
git history of this file is the audit trail. See the 'How to sign' section
The CLA check reads this file from the BASE branch, never from the pull
request under test, so a contribution cannot add itself and pass.
'owners' hold the copyright and are therefore not signing an agreement with
themselves. 'machines' are non-human commit identities: tooling that commits
on behalf of a human who is already covered above. Neither list is a way to
skip the agreement — adding to either is a change to this file, reviewed
'claVersion' must match the version at the top of CLA.md. A signature
recorded against an older one is treated as no signature: the check will not
quietly accept agreement to a document that has since changed materially.
